# Architecture

Ledgerline is one Node.js service (Express) backed by PostgreSQL and an
S3-compatible object store. The same process serves the HTTP API, runs the
import worker, and runs two timers: scheduled exports and the weekly rollup
email. The React components in `src/components/` are bundled

input.body:
label: question
file: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md

Uploaded files are stored temporarily in an S3-compatible object storage. After a successful import, the worker deletes the uploaded file from the object storage, keeping only the parsed transactions. If the import fails, the uploaded file is kept for 7 days to allow inspection, after which it is removed by an hourly purge. This ensures uploaded files are not kept indefinitely, aligning with good security practices.
